records.title: Safe Reinforcement Learning for Contact-Rich Robot Navigation
records.abstract: We enforce control barrier function constraints during policy optimization while preserving sample efficiency and reporting collision rate over five random seeds.
records.referenceTitleZh: 面向富接触机器人导航的安全强化学习
records.referenceAbstractZh: 我们在策略优化过程中施加控制屏障函数约束，同时保持样本效率，并报告五个随机种子下的碰撞率。

records.title: Risk-Sensitive Offline RL under Distribution Shift
records.abstract: Although the behavior policy rarely visits unsafe states, the learned policy must remain feasible when the deployment distribution changes; we therefore optimize CVaR at level α=0.1.
records.referenceTitleZh: 分布偏移下的风险敏感离线强化学习
records.referenceAbstractZh: 尽管行为策略很少访问不安全状态，但当部署分布发生变化时，学习到的策略仍须保持可行；因此，我们优化置信水平 α=0.1 下的条件风险价值（CVaR）。

records.title: Shielded Exploration with Learned Reachability Certificates
records.abstract: The shield intervenes only when the critic predicts that an exploratory action can enter the backward reachable tube, which reduces constraint violations without suppressing useful exploration.
records.referenceTitleZh: 基于学习可达性证书的屏蔽式探索
records.referenceAbstractZh: 仅当评论家网络预测探索动作可能进入反向可达管时，安全屏蔽器才进行干预，从而在不抑制有效探索的情况下减少约束违反。

records.title: Adaptive Residual Balancing for Stiff Physics-Informed Neural Networks
records.abstract: To prevent the PDE residual from dominating sparse boundary observations, we update λ_pde with a gradient-norm controller and stop gradients through the balancing statistic.
records.referenceTitleZh: 面向刚性物理信息神经网络的自适应残差平衡
records.referenceAbstractZh: 为防止偏微分方程残差主导稀疏边界观测，我们利用梯度范数控制器更新 λ_pde，并阻断平衡统计量的梯度传播。

records.title: Causal Training of PINNs for Long-Horizon Wave Propagation
records.abstract: Rather than fitting all collocation points simultaneously, the optimizer unlocks later time slabs only after the normalized residual in the preceding slab falls below 10^-3.
records.referenceTitleZh: 用于长时域波传播的物理信息神经网络因果训练
records.referenceAbstractZh: 优化器并非同时拟合所有配点，而是仅当前一时间片中的归一化残差降至 10^-3 以下后，才解锁更晚的时间片。

records.title: Operator Learning with Conservation-Constrained Latent Dynamics
records.abstract: The encoder maps irregular sensor measurements to a latent field whose evolution conserves mass up to numerical tolerance ε, even for geometries absent from training.
records.referenceTitleZh: 具有守恒约束潜在动力学的算子学习
records.referenceAbstractZh: 编码器将不规则传感器测量映射为潜在场；即使面对训练中未出现的几何形状，该潜在场的演化仍能在数值容差 ε 范围内保持质量守恒。

records.title: Mapless Navigation with Uncertainty-Aware Active Perception
records.abstract: When the depth posterior is multimodal, the robot turns toward the view expected to reduce epistemic uncertainty before committing to a narrow passage.
records.referenceTitleZh: 基于不确定性感知主动感知的无地图导航
records.referenceAbstractZh: 当深度后验呈多峰分布时，机器人会先转向预期可降低认知不确定性的视角，然后再决定进入狭窄通道。

records.title: Socially Compliant Navigation through Counterfactual Pedestrian Prediction
records.abstract: Our planner evaluates how each candidate trajectory would alter pedestrian motion, instead of treating predicted people trajectories as fixed obstacles.
records.referenceTitleZh: 基于反事实行人预测的社会规范导航
records.referenceAbstractZh: 我们的规划器评估每条候选轨迹将如何改变行人运动，而不是将预测的人体轨迹视为固定障碍物。

records.title: Long-Horizon Object-Goal Navigation with Receding-Horizon Memory
records.abstract: A compact topological memory retains failed search branches and is replanned every K=8 steps, preventing the agent from repeatedly revisiting visually similar dead ends.
records.referenceTitleZh: 基于滚动时域记忆的长时域目标物体导航
records.referenceAbstractZh: 紧凑的拓扑记忆会保留失败的搜索分支，并每隔 K=8 步重新规划，从而防止智能体反复访问视觉上相似的死胡同。

records.title: Slip-Aware In-Hand Manipulation from Event-Based Tactile Sensing
records.abstract: The controller reacts to incipient slip events within 12 ms while separating shear-induced taxel activations from vibrations caused by the robot wrist.
records.referenceTitleZh: 基于事件触觉感知的滑移感知手内操作
records.referenceAbstractZh: 控制器可在 12 ms 内响应初始滑移事件，同时区分剪切引起的触觉单元激活与机器人腕部造成的振动。

records.title: Cross-Sensor Tactile Representation Learning without Paired Contacts
records.abstract: A cycle-consistent objective aligns GelSight and DIGIT embeddings even though the two sensors never observe the same physical contact during training.
records.referenceTitleZh: 无需配对接触的跨传感器触觉表征学习
records.referenceAbstractZh: 尽管 GelSight 与 DIGIT 在训练期间从未观测到相同的物理接触，循环一致性目标仍能对齐二者的嵌入表示。

records.title: Visuotactile World Models for Contact-Rich Tool Use
records.abstract: By predicting deformation as an interaction state rather than an auxiliary observation, the world model captures temporal contact dynamics that vision alone misses.
records.referenceTitleZh: 面向富接触工具使用的视觉—触觉世界模型
records.referenceAbstractZh: 世界模型将形变预测为交互状态而非辅助观测，从而捕捉仅凭视觉无法感知的时序接触动力学。

records.title: Differentiable CBF-QP Layers for Safe Policy Improvement
records.abstract: We differentiate through the KKT conditions of the safety filter, but detach infeasible slack penalties to avoid corrupting the actor gradient.
records.referenceTitleZh: 用于安全策略改进的可微 CBF-QP 层
records.referenceAbstractZh: 我们通过安全滤波器的 KKT 条件进行微分，但对不可行松弛惩罚执行梯度分离，以免破坏 Actor 梯度。

records.title: Tube MPC with Learned Disturbance Sets for Agile Quadrotors
records.abstract: The disturbance set expands online when normalized innovation exceeds χ²_0.95, and the ancillary controller keeps the true state inside the tightened tube.
records.referenceTitleZh: 面向敏捷四旋翼的学习扰动集管束模型预测控制
records.referenceAbstractZh: 当归一化新息超过 χ²_0.95 时，扰动集会在线扩张；辅助控制器则使真实状态保持在收紧后的管束内。

records.title: Chance-Constrained MPC for Occlusion-Aware Urban Driving
records.abstract: Occluded pedestrians are represented by reachable occupancy distributions, and the joint collision probability is bounded by δ≤0.05 without assuming independent obstacles.
records.referenceTitleZh: 面向遮挡感知城市驾驶的机会约束模型预测控制
records.referenceAbstractZh: 被遮挡的行人由可达占用分布表示；在不假设各障碍物相互独立的情况下，联合碰撞概率被限制为 δ≤0.05。

records.title: Structure-Preserving Neural ODEs for Underactuated Robot Dynamics
records.abstract: The model parameterizes the inertia matrix through a Cholesky factor and conserves the unforced Hamiltonian, while still learning unknown friction from data.
records.referenceTitleZh: 用于欠驱动机器人动力学的结构保持神经常微分方程
records.referenceAbstractZh: 该模型通过 Cholesky 因子参数化惯性矩阵，并保持无外力哈密顿量守恒，同时仍从数据中学习未知摩擦。

records.title: Multi-Step Latent Dynamics Identification under Partial Observability
records.abstract: Because one-step prediction can ignore slowly varying hidden states, the loss rolls the model forward for H=20 steps and matches both observations and control-conditioned innovations.
records.referenceTitleZh: 部分可观测条件下的多步潜在动力学辨识
records.referenceAbstractZh: 由于单步预测可能忽略缓慢变化的隐藏状态，该损失将模型向前滚动 H=20 步，并同时匹配观测与以控制为条件的新息。

records.title: Residual Dynamics Adaptation for Sim-to-Real Legged Locomotion
records.abstract: A low-rank residual corrects the nominal rigid-body model only where the ensemble epistemic uncertainty is small, preventing extrapolative corrections after contact changes.
records.referenceTitleZh: 面向仿真到真实足式运动的残差动力学适应
records.referenceAbstractZh: 低秩残差仅在集成模型的认知不确定性较小时修正标称刚体模型，从而避免接触变化后进行外推式修正。

records.title: DreamerV3 Meets Safety: Constrained Imagination for Visual Control
records.abstract: SafeDreamer retains the DreamerV3 return objective but masks imagined trajectories whose predicted cumulative cost exceeds the learned budget.
records.referenceTitleZh: DreamerV3 与安全性的结合：面向视觉控制的约束想象
records.referenceAbstractZh: SafeDreamer 保留 DreamerV3 的回报目标，但会屏蔽预测累积代价超过学习预算的想象轨迹。

records.title: RoboMamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling for Mobile Manipulation
records.abstract: RoboMamba fuses proprioception and sparse RGB-D tokens with a selective state-space model, achieving O(T) temporal complexity without discarding long-range dependencies.
records.referenceTitleZh: RoboMamba：用于移动操作的线性时间序列建模
records.referenceAbstractZh: RoboMamba 使用选择性状态空间模型融合本体感知与稀疏 RGB-D 词元，在不丢弃长程依赖的情况下实现 O(T) 时间复杂度。

records.title: Diffusion Policy Policy Optimization without Action-Space Collapse
records.abstract: DPPO updates the denoising policy with clipped likelihood ratios computed over the entire diffusion chain rather than treating each denoising step as an independent action.
records.referenceTitleZh: 避免动作空间坍缩的扩散策略优化
records.referenceAbstractZh: DPPO 使用在整条扩散链上计算的截断似然比更新去噪策略，而不是将每个去噪步骤视为独立动作。

records.title: Learning What to Ignore When the Demonstrator Is Suboptimal
records.abstract: The learner, which receives demonstrations collected by a controller that is safe but inefficient whenever obstacles move, infers which action segments should not constrain its policy.
records.referenceTitleZh: 当示范者并非最优时学习应忽略的内容
records.referenceAbstractZh: 学习器接收由某控制器收集的示范；该控制器在障碍物移动时虽安全但效率低下。学习器据此推断哪些动作片段不应约束其策略。

records.title: Generalization beyond the Terrains on Which the Policy Was Trained
records.abstract: Although the student observes only proprioception, the teacher, whose privileged height map is corrupted during distillation, encourages behaviors that remain stable on unseen compliant terrain.
records.referenceTitleZh: 超越策略训练地形的泛化
records.referenceAbstractZh: 尽管学生网络只能观测本体感知信息，但教师网络在蒸馏期间使用受扰动的特权高度图，由此促使策略在未见过的柔顺地形上仍保持稳定行为。

records.title: Planning with Models That Know When They Do Not Know
records.abstract: A trajectory is accepted only if every ensemble member, including those fit to bootstrap samples that omit rare failures, predicts that its terminal set is recoverable.
records.referenceTitleZh: 利用能够识别自身未知的模型进行规划
records.referenceAbstractZh: 只有当每个集成成员——包括使用遗漏罕见失败案例的自助采样数据拟合的成员——都预测轨迹终端集合可恢复时，该轨迹才会被接受。

records.title: Teacher-Guided Recovery Policies for Humanoid Falls
records.abstract: The recovery policy queries the teacher only after it detects loss of support. This reduces intervention because it can complete ordinary locomotion without privileged state.
records.referenceTitleZh: 教师引导的人形机器人跌倒恢复策略
records.referenceAbstractZh: 恢复策略仅在检测到支撑丧失后才查询教师网络。由于该策略无需特权状态即可完成常规运动，因此这种做法减少了教师干预。

records.title: A Memory-Augmented Critic for Sparse-Reward Manipulation
records.abstract: We train a critic with episodic memory and use it to relabel failed trials. The memory is frozen during policy updates so that their targets do not drift.
records.referenceTitleZh: 用于稀疏奖励操作的记忆增强型 Critic 网络
records.referenceAbstractZh: 我们使用情景记忆训练 Critic 网络，并利用该网络重新标注失败试验。在策略更新期间，情景记忆保持冻结，以防 Critic 目标发生漂移。

records.title: Grounding Language Corrections in Robot Failure Context
records.abstract: After the robot fails, a user describes what went wrong. We bind the correction to the preceding trajectory rather than the object it mentions, because the latter may be ambiguous.
records.referenceTitleZh: 将语言纠错建立在机器人失败上下文之上
records.referenceAbstractZh: 机器人失败后，用户会描述出错原因。我们将纠错信息绑定到先前轨迹，而不是绑定到描述中提及的物体，因为后者可能存在歧义。

records.title: Monotone Policy Improvement under a KL Trust Region
records.abstract: For any update satisfying D_KL(π_new||π_old)≤δ, the surrogate objective lower-bounds the return improvement up to an O(δ²) remainder.
records.referenceTitleZh: KL 信赖域下的单调策略改进
records.referenceAbstractZh: 对于任意满足 D_KL(π_new||π_old)≤δ 的更新，代理目标在忽略 O(δ²) 余项时构成回报改进量的下界。

records.title: Energy-Stable Neural Solvers for Navier–Stokes Equations
records.abstract: The discrete update guarantees E_{t+1}−E_t≤−νΔt||∇u_t||² while a learned closure models unresolved scales on a 128×128 grid.
records.referenceTitleZh: 用于 Navier–Stokes 方程的能量稳定神经求解器
records.referenceAbstractZh: 离散更新保证 E_{t+1}−E_t≤−νΔt||∇u_t||²，同时学习闭合项在 128×128 网格上建模未解析尺度。

records.title: Finite-Time Safety with High-Order Control Barrier Functions
records.abstract: For a relative-degree-r constraint h(x)≥0, we enforce ψ_r(x,u)≥0 and prove entry into the safe set within T≤(V(x_0)/c)^(1−γ).
records.referenceTitleZh: 基于高阶控制屏障函数的有限时间安全性
records.referenceAbstractZh: 对于相对阶为 r 的约束 h(x)≥0，我们施加 ψ_r(x,u)≥0，并证明系统会在 T≤(V(x_0)/c)^(1−γ) 内进入安全集。
